claims.text: The FDA desmopressin injection label identifies systemic or inhaled glucocorticoid use as a severe hyponatremia risk; this covers systemic betamethasone.
claims.quote: Desmopressin acetate is contraindicated in patients at increased risk of severe hyponatremia, such as patients with excessive fluid intake, illnesses that can cause fluid or electrolyte imbalances, and in those using loop diuretics or systemic or inhaled glucocorticoids.

headline.text: The FDA desmopressin injection label identifies systemic glucocorticoid use as a severe hyponatremia risk.

reported.text: The boxed warning covers systemic betamethasone through the glucocorticoid class and lists concomitant use as contraindicated.
